title: use-after-free in the SSL module when SSL_new() fails
lifetime_ender: Py_DECREF(self) on the error path, before self is read
shape: interior pointer into the object that was just released
distinguishing: the stale access is to the freed object ITSELF rather than to anything it pointed at, and no second party is involved at all. The fix is a two-line swap
live_proof: back-patched into the 3.13 branch after v3.13.7
